tools.name: buy_market_brief

tools.name: research_quick

tools.name: grid_load

tools.name: renewable_share

tools.name: flexibility_window

tools.name: bundle_trading

tools.name: optimizer_cheapest_window

tools.name: price_negative_forecast

tools.name: predict_negative_price

tools.name: summary_today

tools.name: region

tools.name: events_grid

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: research, articles_id, tasks, articles_id_post · Private data: summary_today, events_grid · Public sink: buy_market_brief, research, articles_id, tasks, research_post, articles_id_post, tasks_post, renewable_share, signals_buy_sell, subscribe_price_alert, subscribe_co2_low, region.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: research, articles_id, tasks, articles_id_post · Private data: summary_today, events_grid · Public sink: buy_market_brief, research, articles_id, tasks, research_post, articles_id_post, tasks_post, renewable_share, signals_buy_sell, subscribe_price_alert, subscribe_co2_low, region

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "price_forecast" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
